user.title: Find Your School District
user.description:
Enter your school district's name (for example Souderton or Fairfax County Public Schools), its Nutrislice address (for example my-district.nutrislice.com), or paste any link from your school's Nutrislice menu.

Not sure? Find your school with [Nutrislice Lookup]({lookup_url}) and paste the page address it opens.

school.title: Select School
school.description: Found {count} school(s) in: {districts}. Select your school. If it isn't listed, start over and try a different search, or paste a link from your school's Nutrislice menu.

menu_types.title: Select Menus to Track
menu_types.description: Choose which meal menus you want to track for {school_name}:
